senses.gloss:
दुच्छक दुच्छक, अस्, m. a kind of perfume,
= गन्ध-कुटी, = विहाराद्यवकाशक (?).

दुच्छुना दुच्छुना, f. (fr. दुस् + शुन?), Ved.
misfortune, calamity; injury, evil, often personified as
a malicious being or evil spirit; [cf. अ-दुच्छुन.]

दुच्छुनाय, Nom. A. दुच्छुनायते, &c., Ved.
to wish to injure or hurt, to be evil disposed.
